title: Booking confirmation and reminder
summary: Emails a confirmation when a booking is made and a reminder the day before it starts.
description: Two workflows for any table of bookings, appointments or reservations. The confirmation goes out the moment the row is created; the reminder runs every hour and emails everyone whose booking starts within the next 24 hours, once. Cancelled and declined bookings are skipped. It adds one field, reminder_sent_at, so nobody is reminded twice.

params.label: Bookings table
params.description: The table of bookings, appointments or reservations.

params.name: tz

notes: A bookings table with a start time and a ref to a person who has an email field.
